name: Nocturnal-Armillary
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in massive canyon systems. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the ancient alien ruins left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
